fields.name: userId
fields.description: IAM user id (OIDC sub) this config belongs to. One row per user; the read+write hooks filter by currentUser.id so only the owner reads/writes. Completely separate from UserAiConfig — this row only powers the AI-generated profile picture flow.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Provider id for the avatar generator. Currently 'replicate' (the only model we ship styles for: fofr/face-to-many). Empty/missing is treated as 'replicate' by the proxy. Maps to the `x-ai-avatar-provider` request header on `/api/ai/avatar`.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Bearer token for the avatar provider (Replicate API token). Required for AI avatar generation. No server-side fallback — if missing the AI avatar button is hidden and only the manual profile picture upload works. Marked PII because it is a credential.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Optional override for the Replicate model id (e.g. 'fofr/face-to-many'). Empty string means the proxy uses its server-side default.
